builds.name: Reference: Multi-target carry
builds.goal: Reference for Sivir: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A ranged teamfight attacker who clears through ricochets, blocks one spell and uses team speed to maintain contact. Compare ricochet waves/attacks with Q poke and spell-shield timing. Crit/lethality affect different parts of the kit; actual bounce eligibility must be confirmed. Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output.
builds.summary: Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output.
testPlan: Kit question for Sivir: Compare ricochet waves/attacks with Q poke and spell-shield timing. Crit/lethality affect different parts of the kit; actual bounce eligibility must be confirmed.

Start with the early core (Yun Tal, then Runaan) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Runaan asks whether real multi-target attacks improve teamfight output. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing damage each way. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
